trigger.disposition: Correct fail-closed behaviour; the defect was the native request omitting outSR.

observation_method.method: Live REST reads of the public MINAM service from an independent fetcher; values transcribed, not byte-frozen. Byte freezing is performed by the Gate A capture itself.

official_semantics.source: Esri ArcGIS REST API, Query (Map Service/Layer)
official_semantics.outSR_omitted: geometry is returned in the spatial reference of the map
official_semantics.inSR: spatial reference of the input geometry filter only; no geometry filter is used, so inSR has no effect on these queries
official_semantics.sourceSpatialReference: reports the spatial reference features are stored in the source dataset

findings.projection_consistency_check: UTM 18S (WGS84) inverse of the 32718 vertex reproduces the 4326 vertex to sub-millimetre; both share the WGS84 datum, so no datum transformation is involved
findings.storage_grid_hint: 32718 coordinates sit on a 0.0001 m grid; 4326 coordinates carry computed floating-point noise

mechanism_adjustment.native_request: f=json with outSR equal to the layer sourceSpatialReference read from the metadata captured in the same run and cross-checked against the contract (32718); no datumTransformation
mechanism_adjustment.geojson_request_unchanged: outSR=4326, recorded as a server projection
mechanism_adjustment.residual_caveat: Identity of outSR=32718 output with the stored coordinates follows from ArcGIS semantics and the metadata; the REST API does not expose storage bytes, so byte identity to the underlying dataset is not asserted.
